headline: Georgian Court's unbeaten run ends at Queens
dek: Georgian Court had won twice and drawn twice before the defeat at Queens, the last unbeaten record in the conference. Every programme in the CACC has now been beaten at least once, with the whole of conference play still ahead.
displaced_by: Georgian Court lost at Queens; no CACC side is still unbeaten

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Georgian Court's thirteen goals have come from seven different scorers, and Sander Rynning has three of them. The tallest bar is a spread of contributions rather than one player's tally.

wire.line: Jefferson have lost all five of their matches, and after Georgian Court's defeat at Queens every other side has lost at least once.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jefferson have lost all five of their matches, conceding fourteen goals against three scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Chestnut Hill's win at Virginia State levels their record at two wins, two draws and two losses, with ten goals scored and eleven conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wilmington's defeat at Southern New Hampshire leaves them with two wins, one draw and two losses, seven goals scored and eleven conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dominican have scored one goal all season, drawing once and losing three times with nine conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Max Bond has made 35 saves for Chestnut Hill and conceded eight, a save percentage of .814.

last_match.line: Georgian Court's first defeat of the season; Queens have now beaten every CACC side they have met except Holy Family.

next_match.line: Felician have not won since beating American International and have conceded in every match since; Gannon drew at Post.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
